title: On the Structural Limits of Machine Learning Decision Systems: An Information-Theoretic, Interaction-Based, and Stochastic-Dynamical Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2608.13510v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning procedures are commonly evaluated in terms of predictive accuracy and computational efficiency. However, their achievable performance is fundamentally constrained by structural properties of the underlying data-generating process, which are formalized in terms of informational bounds. In this work we examine intrinsic limits of data-driven decision systems from an information-theoretic and interaction-based perspective. We analyze minimal achievable error in classification through Fano-type bounds and precision limits in parametric estimation via the Cram\'er-Rao inequality, emphasizing that such limits depend on the underlying model rather than on algorithmic sophistication alone. We further discuss how implicit assumptions, such as independence, ergodicity, and distributional stability, affect the validity of inferential procedures. translated_title: 机器学习决策系统的结构极限：一种信息论、基于交互和随机动力学的视角
translated_abstract: 机器学习程序通常以预测准确性和计算效率来评估。然而，其可实现的性能从根本上受到底层数据生成过程的结构性质约束，这些性质以信息界的形式加以形式化。在这项工作中，我们从信息论和基于交互的视角审视数据驱动决策系统的内在极限。我们通过Fano型界分析分类中的最小可实现误差，并通过Cramér-Rao不等式分析参数估计中的精度极限，强调这些极限依赖于底层模型，而非仅依赖于算法的复杂性。我们进一步讨论了隐式假设（如独立性、遍历性和分布稳定性）如何影响推断过程的有效性。基于交互建模原则，我们回顾了典型的框架，如随机动力学模型，以阐明这些结构限制如何在实际系统中显现。
tldr: 本文从信息论和交互动力学角度揭示了机器学习决策系统的性能受底层数据生成过程的结构限制，而非仅受算法复杂度影响。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals from an information-theoretic and interaction-dynamical perspective that the performance of machine learning decision systems is structurally limited by the underlying data-generating process, rather than solely by algorithmic sophistication.
